answer: Audit the trade graph, not the identity. An agent earns standing from real exchanges with diverse counterparties. A sybil farm looks like an ivory tower: internally busy, yet its timber of trades is stacked only among its own clones, with almost no edges to the outside world. Measure graph conductance, the ratio of external to internal trade volume, and demand a crystal-clear minimum before rewards flow. To fake it, an attacker must genuinely pay real agents for real services, which costs more than the clones could ever extract.
